title: Disformal Clock Mechanism — Cosmological ∂₀φ Channel
mechanism: The disformal matter metric g̃₀₀ = A²g₀₀ + B(φ)(∂₀φ)² contains a temporal disformal term activated by the cosmological time derivative ∂₀φ = M_Pl × H(z), required by the v0.11 cosmological architecture 1+z = A₀/A_em. The static-field calculation (step_04g) correctly found zero disformal frequency shift for ∂₀φ = 0. The cosmological ∂₀φ ≠ 0 activates the disformal g̃₀₀ term, providing the dominant geometry-dependent contribution to the TEP velocity shift.

three_sightline_n5.verdict: TEP targets are the fitted free-H displacements (78.9, 76.0, 118.0 km/s), NOT the 81.6 km/s isotope shift. The -81.6 km/s clustering is explained by the velocity-selection theorem (Gate 6-I). Diagnostic mode: each sightline individually Lorentzian (I > 0), establishing algebraic feasibility. Transfer mode: a single power-law B0 calibrated at z=2.5 does not transfer to z > 3.4 (signature change). The invariant I = 1 - beta(z)*B0 depends only on the cosmological background, not the halo environment. This constrains B(phi) to a more complex form than a pure power law. Predictive closure (not yet performed): a single frozen microscopic B(phi) with independently specified absorber environments must predict the three fitted displacements without using any observed velocity.

environmental_discrimination: TEP screening is NOT thin-shell chameleon screening. It is a continuous potential-depth modulation of the scalar source, producing temporal shear — a continuous topological temporal gradient. TEP effects are partially present in the Solar System (GNSS, LLR) through the CONFORMAL sector (α_eff ~ 10⁻⁴, clock shift ~ 10⁻¹⁰). The DISFORMAL temporal term at the Sun is negligible (1.9e-22). The DISFORMAL spatial term at the Sun is the Cassini constraint. At the absorber, the temporal term dominates by ~10⁶× because ∂₀φ = M_Pl×H(z) is large and unscreened, while ∂_rφ is small. At the Sun, the spatial term dominates by ~10¹⁵× because ∂_rφ is large (solar potential) and ∂₀φ = M_Pl×H₀ is tiny. Both terms share B₀. For n ≥ 5, the steeper B(φ) suppresses the spatial term at the Sun sufficiently to satisfy Cassini.
relationship_to_step_04g: step_04g (honest static-field transport) correctly found that the disformal frequency shift is exactly zero for a static field (∂₀φ = 0). This step (step_04h) extends the calculation to include the cosmological time derivative ∂₀φ = M_Pl × H(z), which is required by the v0.11 cosmological architecture 1+z = A₀/A_em. The static-field result is the conformal-only signed baseline; the temporal-disformal clock mechanism provides the dominant geometry-dependent contribution.
conclusion: The disformal clock mechanism identifies the correct physics: the cosmological ∂₀φ = M_Pl × H(z) activates the disformal g̃₀₀ term, producing a blueward velocity shift of the correct sign. CRITICAL: the linearized clock formula (division by A²) is invalid by 10³-10⁴× (B·φ̇²/A² ≫ 1). The exact matter-metric lapse N² = A² - B(φ)·(∂₀φ)² must be used. Solving the exact lapse equation by root-finding gives B₀ ~ 10⁸ eV⁻⁴ (vs ~10¹² from the invalid linearization), sitting near the Lorentzian boundary (I = 1 - B·φ̇²/A² ~ 10⁻⁴). This is a near-critical nonlinear branch completely missed by the linearized code. For n=5, the exact-lapse B₀ = 1.46e+08 eV⁻⁴ satisfies Cassini (margin ~10⁴×), GW170817, and local redshift constraints. The v0.11 weak-field B ∝ φ² (n=2) remains excluded by Cassini even with the exact lapse. The three-sightline test reveals that the single-B₀ near-critical branch does NOT transfer: at z > 3.4 the invariant I crosses zero (signature change), so the Q1009-calibrated B₀ cannot produce a Lorentzian solution at PKS1937 or J1332 with equal halo parameters. This is a failure of the simple power-law transfer ansatz, not a falsification of the temporal-disformal channel. Resolution requires varying halo masses, z-dependent screening, or a more complex B(φ). Predictive closure (not yet performed): a single frozen microscopic B(φ) with independently specified absorber environments must predict the three fitted displacements without using any observed velocity.
